$comment: Descriptive data map, not an executable validation schema. Technical identifiers follow the source; editing this file changes no runtime behavior. Shared JSON body reads have a ten-second deadline. AI responses are bounded at 2,000,000 decoded bytes and results at 750,000 serialized UTF-8 bytes before ledger persistence.

x-authority.description: Actual contracts: Firestore Rules, AI/API Zod schemas, history/profile readers and server-api.ts. Updating this file changes no validation, migration or access policy.

FirestoreTimestamp.description: Native Firestore timestamp; this is not a prescribed JSON serialization.

UserProfile.title: User profile
UserProfile.description: Profiles may be partial after an Admin coin increment; account bootstrap repairs missing public fields. Email remains in Auth, not the public profile. Runtime reader and Rules define actual acceptance.

QuizHistory.title: Quiz history

schemaVersion.description: New writes use 2. The reader treats absence as legacy version 1, supports both permanently and rejects unsupported versions.

QuizHistory.description: The writer persists userId and schemaVersion while the reader supplies the document ID separately. Legacy defaults come from history-schema.ts. Quiz completion awaits a stable-ID write, and the persistence DTO omits absent optional values.

UserActivity.title: Calendar activity

activeDays.description: Keys are local calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD.

UserActivity.description: ActivityCalendar calls trackToday when ready. This records an active day, not proof of quiz completion.

ForumPost.title: Forum post
ForumPost.description: Authenticated server deletion atomically removes the parent and records an owner recovery tombstone, then recursively deletes descendants. Updated Rules gate comment reads on a live, non-tombstoned parent; legacy orphans are inaccessible but are not automatically migrated.

ArenaExam.title: Arena exam
ArenaExam.description: Public V2 metadata contains no question bank or answers. Legacy plaintext documents are denied by Rules and can be migrated only as non-rewarded practice with a private backup.

ArenaAnswerKey.description: Admin-only full question bank; prompts are released after server start, canonical review after accepted submission.

timingVersion.description: Absent on legacy attempts, which are excluded from the timed leaderboard.

ArenaSession.title: Private Arena timing session

startedAtMs.description: Server-observed Unix milliseconds; start retries preserve this value.

answerFingerprint.description: Written only after the session is consumed.

result.description: Stored submission response for idempotent replay after session consumption.

ArenaSession.description: User/exam-bound server start, question fingerprint, consumed answer fingerprint/result and 24-hour expiry. Admin only.

RequestReceipt.title: Idempotency receipt

expiresAt.description: New receipts expire seven days after creation; legacy records may lack this field pending backfill.

RequestReceipt.description: Server hashes scope/UID/requestId to form the document ID. Admin dates are stored as Timestamp. A seven-day application retry window and ordinary expiry query index are declared; the signed Spark worker performs bounded deletion; retained receipts remain replayable until asynchronous deletion.

arenaCreate.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header

request.title: trimmed string, 1 to 200 characters
request.config: complete Arena configuration; 1 to 50 questions and optional timer through 999 minutes
request.questions: 1 to 50 complete validated Arena questions; short-answer keys use the supported numeric format

limits.body: 900,000 UTF-8 bytes, enforced while streaming; Content-Length is not trusted

arenaCreate.description: Admin-derived identity and complete validation; public metadata, private keys, contribution/byte budget and receipt commit atomically. Direct browser mutations are denied.

arenaStart.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header
arenaStart.description: Returns prompts without keys and server startedAtMs. Replay and distinct IDs preserve the first eligible clock; sessions are user/exam-bound, fingerprinted and logically expire after 24 hours.

arenaSubmit.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header

request.answers: string[]; maximum 50 entries, each maximum 2000 characters; streamed body maximum 128000 bytes
request.requestId: required UUID of an acknowledged start

arenaSubmit.description: Canonical server grading and duration. Only a first eligible non-author completion is ranked/rewarded; authors, retakes, expired timing and migrated practice are excluded. Atomic compact result/receipt, counter and reward; canonical review follows acceptance. Only timingVersion 1/rankingVersion 2 entries rank with score DESC, duration ASC, ID ASC before limit 10.

forumCreate.request: title, content, subject and required UUID
forumCreate.description: Admin-authored identity, schema/byte budget, atomic post/receipt.

learningDataExport.description: Bounded pages of explicitly supported private learning datasets; tagged values and continuation. Auth identity excludes credentials. Not a complete account/community/AI export or atomic snapshot.

accountRequests.description: Legacy bounded/idempotent export/deletion-review requests and owner-only statuses. These records never trigger automated deletion; current self-service uses separately configured account jobs. Public operator contact is configured; no fulfilment SLA is claimed.

forumMutation.request: required UUID and edit-post/edit-comment/desired-state like mutation

communityReport.description: Validated target, reason, UUID and budget; private report queue.

moderation.description: Bounded private queue; attributable idempotent dismiss/hide/restore, with archive/counter/tombstone safeguards.

forumCommentCreate.budget: Per-user/global comment count and byte token buckets commit with the comment/counter
forumCommentCreate.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header

limits.body: 16,384 UTF-8 bytes, enforced while streaming; Content-Length is not trusted

forumCommentCreate.description: The transaction verifies a valid live parent and rejects an existing deletion tombstone before writing the comment and counter.

forumCommentDelete.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header; comment author required
forumCommentDelete.description: Deletion is transactional but does not currently use an idempotency receipt.

forumPostDelete.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header; post author required
forumPostDelete.description: The owner transaction removes public parent visibility and creates a persistent pending tombstone before Admin recursive deletion. Owner retry resumes a failed cascade; a completed tombstone makes retry idempotent and prevents post-ID reuse. No background cleanup worker or tombstone TTL exists.

aiGenerationProtocol.transport: Authenticated Next.js Route Handlers with a Firestore generation ledger
aiGenerationProtocol.authentication: Firebase ID token in Authorization: Bearer header; guest access denied
aiGenerationProtocol.validation: Zod input/output validation plus operation-specific cross-field checks
aiGenerationProtocol.state: At most three server-ordered attempts; one OpenRouter request per attempt-route invocation; idempotent status recovery and explicit cancellation
aiGenerationProtocol.quota: Two concurrent generations per user; 30 weighted attempts per 15-minute user window; global ceiling 300
aiGenerationProtocol.description: Creation is gated by AI_GENERATION_PROTOCOL_ENABLED; deployment acceptance and operational evidence are tracked in the audit report.

accountJobs.authority: src/lib/jobs/types.ts, store.ts, queue.ts, worker.ts; owner API or exact raw-body QStash signature; minimal read-only deletion receipt
accountJobs.artifactIntegrity: Ciphertext and plaintext SHA-256; manifest JSON filenames match downloads; native private-prefix version cleanup is bounded and includes uncheckpointed uploads.
accountJobs.communityScope: Collection-group matches restricted to posts/{id}/comments/{id} and arenaExams/{id}/attempts/{id}; never another owner private tree.

/users/{uid}.description: Known-UID profile lookup; collection listing denied. Legacy private/unknown fields make a profile owner-only until repaired. Email remains in Firebase Auth. Public fields are owner-writable, root deletion and coin changes are server-controlled.

/users/{uid}/activity/main.description: Owner-only activity. Each write merges precisely one activeDays date leaf and updatedAt; account snapshots are isolated.

/posts/{postId}.description: Public-read feed; validated/budgeted Admin APIs own creation, owner edits and desired-state likes. Direct browser writes/deletion are denied.

/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Comment reads require a live, non-tombstoned parent. All mutations use authenticated, validated/budgeted Admin APIs; direct browser writes are denied.

/arenaExams/{examId}.description: Public-read V2 metadata only; feed requires schemaVersion == 2. Authenticated Admin APIs own creation and scoring; direct browser writes/deletion are denied.

/_arenaSessions/{hash}.description: Admin-only server timing with a 24-hour logical lifetime and ordinary expiresAt query index for signed bounded Spark cleanup.

/_arenaAnswerKeys/{examId}.description: Admin-only answer bank; no automatic TTL while the exam exists.

/_arenaEligibility/{hash}.description: Admin-only uid/examId firstStartedAtMs; persists across UUID/session expiry to prevent timing eligibility reset.

/_arenaLegacyBackups/{examId}.description: Admin-only pre-migration snapshot and backedUpAt; retained for operator recovery, no automatic TTL.

/_communityReports/{id}.description: Private reporterId, target, reason, status and decision metadata; budgeted authenticated report API and authorized moderation API only.

/_accountRequests/{hash}.description: Private uid/kind/pending-operator request and timestamp; owner API only, no client Rules grant. No automatic execution or configured fulfilment/retention policy.

/_moderationArchives/{hash}.description: Private reversible hidden-content snapshot, actor, reason and time; restore respects live parents and deletion tombstones.

/_moderationActions/{id}.description: Private attributable moderation action log; server-owned, no browser access or default TTL.

/_requestReceipts/{hash}.description: Admin-only receipts, no client Rule grant.

/_aiGenerations/{generationId}.description: Admin-only short-lived AI generation state, validated input during processing and validated result for recovery; browser Rules explicitly deny access.

/_forumDeletions/{postId}.description: Server-written deletion recovery tombstone: authorId, pending/complete status, createdAt and optional completedAt. Owner-readable, no client writes, no TTL; retained to authorize cascade retries and prevent post ID reuse.

/_aiQuota/{scope}.description: Admin-only first-reservation-anchored attempt budget and active-reservation state; browser Rules explicitly deny access.

/_requestBudgets/{scope}.description: Admin-only token buckets for request/count/byte admission. Creation budget and generation writes commit atomically. An ordinary expiry query index is declared for bounded signed cleanup; no native TTL is requested on Spark.

/users/{uid}/preferences/service.description: Owner-only self-declared age 16+ confirmation, policyVersion and acceptedAt; no DOB. Client consent gate precedes learning features.

/_accountJobs/{uuid}.description: Admin-only durable export/deletion/backup state: kind, environment, status, ownerUid until deletion completion, cursor, artifact metadata, progress, lease, nextRunAtMs and logical expiry.

/_accountLocks/{uid}.description: Admin-only deletion/deleted write tombstone; Rules/Admin mutations reject new writes. Active deletion retained until completion; deleted tombstone seven days.

/_deletionJournal/{uid}.description: Admin-only restore-prevention journal, 30 days after completion; active deletion entries cannot expire. Applied with the current source journal before isolated restore.

/_jobWorkerState/lease.description: Admin-only shared maintenance/job lease with random fencing token and deadline.

/_jobBudgets/{environment_day}.description: Admin-only conservative daily QStash reservation including initial delivery and retries; private ordinary expiry.

/_serviceState/{state}.description: Admin-only bounded backup write barrier and rotating retention checkpoint. No browser reads or writes.

localStorage.shark_lang: Shared UI language preference: en or vi
localStorage.shark_theme: Shared UI theme preference: light or dark
localStorage.shark_roadmap_checks:v2:{uid}: UID-scoped boolean map keyed by stored subject/grade/topic tuple and persisted bilingual recommendation pair; independent of locale and display order
localStorage.shark_roadmap_checks:{uid}: Legacy positional account map; retained unchanged, not automatically imported into v2
localStorage.shark_roadmap_checks: Legacy unscoped key; retained but not automatically assigned to a user
localStorage.shark.account-deletion-receipt: Essential minimal read-only deletion receipt; no UID/content in receipt payload; server access expires seven days after completion.

sessionStorage.shark:draft:v1:{uid}:{kind}: Validated same-tab Quiz/Practice/Flashcard/Arena checkpoints; 24-hour logical inactivity expiry, max 1 MB per key, removed on owner change/sign-out or explicit discard/completion. No cross-device guarantee.

x-derived-data.description: Calendar month grouping derives from users/{uid}/activity/main.activeDays. Roadmap checks and language/theme use localStorage, not these collections. Locale/theme also use the essential validated preference cookie; server and client start from the same valid cookie when present.

cookies.shark_preferences: Essential version/language/theme preference; v1.en.light or v1.vi.dark; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; up to one year; Secure on HTTPS. Validated SSR/client preference, with legacy localStorage migration.

x-account-operations.ageVerification: Self-declared eligibility and policy-version confirmation; no date of birth
x-account-operations.transport: QStash signed ID/environment messages; durable Firestore outbox, per-job/global leases and checkpoints
x-account-operations.storage: Private per-environment B2 bucket; gzip plus AES-256-GCM, filename AAD and SHA-256 integrity; 7 GB production / 1 GB staging internal ceilings
x-account-operations.retention: AI access rejects expired records; bounded signed Firestore cleanup via RETENTION_ENABLED independently of B2/account jobs, with transactional expiry rechecks; no native TTL
x-account-operations.export: Full attributable catalog plus discovered private descendants; live paged reads; processing at most seven days, owner download access 24 hours after ready, processing object fallback expiry eight days; failed processing remains visible 24 hours; manifest declares lifetime and status gives authoritative deadline; legacy unattributable receipts excluded pending retention
x-account-operations.deletion: New explicit recent-auth confirmation only; lock writes, cancel AI, remove private data, anonymize public/archive identity/reactions, Auth last; minimal receipt/tombstone seven days and deletion journal 30 days
x-account-operations.backup: Daily when enabled; seven-day encrypted artifacts, bounded write barrier; isolated empty-target restore applies current deletion journal; RPO/RTO unverified
